worms > Phylum Annelida > Class Polychaeta

Order Sabellida > Family Sabellidae

Olive fanworm
awaiting identification*
Family Sabellidaeupdated Oct 2016

Where seen? This fanworm is sometimes seen in silty, sandy areas near seagrass meadows on many of our shores.

Features: Fan 6-8cm in diameter. Included in this page are those with a fan generally olive brown sometimes with tinges of black. Often it has a rather ‘untidy’ look. Usually found alone in sand.


Tanah Merah, Oct 09


Tanah Merah, Oct 09

Sometimes appears ‘untidy’. Changi, Jul 09

***Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
